independent_spatial_review.coordinate_operation_independently_repro: Inverse of TM35FIN + EUREF-FIN to WGS 84 (1), nominal operation accuracy 1 m; not a measurement of point accuracy or campus offset.
independent_spatial_review.scope: National parent-parcel reference point lies inside the western ASP campus shown by the named original applicant plans. The parent polygon also includes copper factories and is not the ASP campus boundary.
independent_spatial_review.alignment_method: Independent original PDF vector-to-national-building footprint alignment. pdftocairo converted the first page of the original noise-map PDF to SVG; three distinctive corners of the western copper-factory outline were paired with the original national open building footprint. A three-point affine fit in centred EPSG:3067 coordinates mapped the unmodified MML parcel reference point onto the PDF page. A fourth corner on the independent eastern copper-factory building checks the fit. No building point or PDF-derived coordinate replaces the national locator.
independent_spatial_review.map_pdf_coordinate_convention: PDF page points, x from left and y from top, page approximately 1190.52 by 841.92 points
independent_spatial_review.visual_containment: Mapped point at PDF x≈535.86, y≈458.85 (1800px rendering x≈810, y≈694) is well inside the outlined western campus, in its southern portion, west of the existing copper factories. Cross-checked against original Sweco stormwater pages 3, 5 and 20. This is a visual campus containment validation, not a surveyed campus boundary or assertion of active works precisely at that point.
limitations: Source parent parcel is broader than the ASP campus.
Point is not a DC6 footprint, entrance, building centre, phase-specific locator or legal campus boundary.
Building-footprint alignment is only a validation aid; plan basemap and footprints may have generalization or differing survey epochs.
The fit residual is not a quantified uncertainty for the campus locator.
No restricted municipal WFS geometry or third-party map coordinate was used.
